fields.title: Welcome to Progress RPG
fields.body: Progress RPG turns real-life effort into progress. Use the tutorial arrows to see more instructions, then press Done when you are ready to play.

fields.title: It's all about you
fields.body: As you log activity, you earn XP and level up. Keep returning to build steady progress.

fields.title: Start a focus session
fields.body: Choose what you want to work on, start the timer, and stay with it. Completed focus time becomes activity that earns XP.

fields.title: Recent activities
fields.body: Your completed sessions appear in recent activity. You can hover over individual activities and click the 'play' button to repeat them.
